Container.Name: Silo
Container.Overview:
Silo is a self-hosted media server for your films and series. Point it at your media folders and stream to your devices - at home or away - with direct play, remuxing and hardware-accelerated transcoding handled automatically.
A full-featured web client and admin interface ship with the server. An optional Jellyfin/Emby-compatible API lets you keep using clients you already own, such as Infuse, VidHub and Findroid. Household profiles give each member their own watch state and parental controls, and metadata is matched through installable plugins including TMDB and TVDB.
The AIO image includes PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector and Redis, so a new installation needs only this container and a SECRET_KEY. Meilisearch is off by default. Advanced View lets you disable bundled Redis or enable Meilisearch, and set DATABASE_URL or REDIS_URL to use external services. PostgreSQL is disabled when DATABASE_URL is set. Meilisearch needs Redis and starts the bundled Redis when no external REDIS_URL is set, even if ENABLE_REDIS is false.
Persistent state, including the bundled database, lives in /config. The default host path is /mnt/user/appdata/silo-aio. This is a fresh-install layout: changing an existing installation's image tag does not migrate its separate database. Keep the old containers, data, and SECRET_KEY until a data migration has been completed and verified. See the README before updating an existing installation.
Hardware transcoding is optional. For Intel or AMD, add --device=/dev/dri:/dev/dri to Advanced View's Extra Parameters, alongside the existing parameters, only when /dev/dri exists on the host. For NVIDIA, install the Unraid Nvidia-Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Advanced View's Extra Parameters alongside the existing parameters, and enter your GPU UUID in the NVIDIA GPU UUID field. Silo's automatic hardware detection will select NVENC.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: silo media server streaming films movies tv series shows jellyfin emby plex transcode
Container.Requires: A SECRET_KEY is required: generate one with openssl rand -base64 48. PostgreSQL and Redis are bundled; no separate service containers are required for the default installation. Existing installations need a data migration before switching to the bundled database; see the README.
Container.Changes:
### 2026.10.29 - Use the AIO image with bundled PostgreSQL and Redis; leave Meilisearch off by default. - Store persistent state under /config, with a separate fresh-install appdata path. - Add service controls and Unraid file ownership settings. - Allow two minutes for shutdown and limit container memory to 4 GiB. - Store prepared offline downloads outside docker.img.
### 2026.10.05 - Restart Silo automatically when it starts before PostgreSQL or Redis is ready.
### 7.3.2 - Initial Community Applications release. - Avoid passing an empty GPU device on systems without /dev/dri.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Silo web interface and API.

Config.Name: Jellyfin-Compatible API Port
Config.Description: Port for the optional Jellyfin/Emby-compatible API, used by clients such as Infuse, VidHub and Findroid. Disabled until an administrator enables it in admin settings. Change this if you already run Jellyfin on 8096.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf-Compatible API Port
Config.Description: Port for the optional Audiobookshelf-compatible API. Change this if you already run Audiobookshelf on 13378.

Config.Name: Media Data
Config.Description: Root share containing your film and series libraries. The host and container paths are identical so paths remain consistent across your media stack. Mounted read-only - Silo never writes to your media.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Silo state and bundled PostgreSQL, Redis, and Meilisearch data. Use a fresh directory for a new AIO installation. Back up this directory with the container stopped, and keep SECRET_KEY separately.

Config.Name: Transcode Scratch
Config.Description: Temporary transcode files, stored outside docker.img. Choose fast local storage with room for active streams. You can use /tmp/silo-transcode on the host for RAM-backed storage if enough memory is available.

Config.Name: Download Artifacts
Config.Description: Transcoded copies that Silo prepares for offline downloads. Only used when an administrator enables transcoded downloads; files can be large and are regenerated on demand, so you can leave this folder out of backups. Keep it mapped - otherwise the files are written inside docker.img. If playback.transcode_dir moves to another parent directory, update this mount or set download.artifact_dir to this mounted directory.

Config.Name: Host meminfo
Config.Description: Read-only view of host memory, used to auto-tune database settings. Leave as-is.

Config.Name: MODE
Config.Description: Deployment mode. Leave as 'integrated' for a normal single-server install.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Master key for at-rest credential encryption - the server will not start without it. Generate one by opening an Unraid terminal and running: openssl rand -base64 48 -- Back this up separately from your database. If you lose it, encrypted secrets cannot be recovered.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional external PostgreSQL 18 database with pgvector. Leave blank to use bundled PostgreSQL. Setting a URL disables bundled PostgreSQL; it does not migrate any data. Use a reachable host address, not a Docker service name on the default bridge.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Optional external Redis 6.2 or newer. Leave blank to use the bundled Redis when enabled. Setting a URL disables bundled Redis and takes precedence over ENABLE_REDIS. Use a reachable host address on the default bridge.

Config.Name: ENABLE_REDIS
Config.Description: Start bundled Redis for Watch Party and shared state. Set false to disable it when no feature needs Redis. Meilisearch requires Redis and enables the bundle even when this is false, unless REDIS_URL points to an external Redis.

Config.Name: ENABLE_MEILISEARCH
Config.Description: Start bundled Meilisearch for search. Off by default: PostgreSQL handles search. Enabling it also starts bundled Redis unless REDIS_URL is set. Set false to stop bundled Meilisearch and return its managed search configuration to PostgreSQL.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for Silo and its application files. Defaults to Unraid's nobody user. Choose an ID that can read your media. Bundled services use their own accounts.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for Silo and its application files. Defaults to Unraid's users group. Choose a group that can read your media.

Config.Name: SILO_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR
Config.Description: Where plugins are cached inside the container. Leave as-is.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_TUNE
Config.Description: Leave blank for automatic tuning of bundled PostgreSQL only, with a 50 percent memory budget. External PostgreSQL is not tuned by default. Set auto only to explicitly allow tuning of an external server, or off to disable all tuning.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU UUID
Config.Description: Optional NVIDIA hardware transcoding. Install the Unraid Nvidia-Driver plugin, copy a GPU UUID from its settings into this field (or use 'all'), and add --runtime=nvidia to Advanced View's Extra Parameters alongside the existing parameters. Leave blank when NVIDIA is not used.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA runtime capabilities required for CUDA, NVENC/NVDEC and GPU diagnostics. Leave as-is when using NVIDIA; harmless when the NVIDIA GPU UUID is blank.
